intro: JNTUH College of Engineering and St Ann's College for Women both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded MSc fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

JNTUH College of Engineering vs St Ann's College for Women is not a single winner. JNTUH College of Engineering is recorded as a public institute, while St Ann's College for Women is private. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: JNTUH College of Engineering vs St Ann's College for Women for MSc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose JNTUH College of Engineering if you want a public MSc option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose St Ann's College for Women if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.

JNTUH College of Engineering lists Master of Science(M.Sc.) Marine Microbiology & Marine Drugs, Master of Science(M.Sc.) Mathematics, Master of Science(M.Sc.) Organic Chemistry and more. St Ann's College for Women lists Master of Science(M.Sc.) Chemistry, Master of Science(M.Sc.) Mathematics.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹33,000 a year as tuition fees for JNTUH College of Engineering's Master of Science(M.Sc.) Marine Microbiology & Marine Drugs. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹27,055 a year as tuition fees for St Ann's College for Women's Master of Science(M.Sc.) Chemistry. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, JNTUH College of Engineering's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh for Master of Science(M.Sc.) Marine Microbiology & Marine Drugs. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, St Ann's College for Women's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh for Master of Science(M.Sc.) Chemistry. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for JNTUH College of Engineering on this MSc page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for St Ann's College for Women on this MSc page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Hyderabad, Telangana. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, JNTUH College of Engineering is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
St Ann's College for Women can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
